args.sql:
WITH EfficiencyMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.flowsoft AS processing_software,
        sp.flowstage AS processing_stage,
        AVG(sp.flowhrs) AS avg_processing_hours,
        AVG(sp.proccpu) AS avg_cpu_usage_percent,
        AVG(sp.procgpu) AS avg_gpu_usage_percent,
        AVG(s.gbsize) AS avg_data_size_gb,
        AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage_gb,
        -- Calculate efficiency using the PRU formula
        (
            AVG(sp.flowhrs * (sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2) /
            AVG(s.gbsize * 10 * LOG(10, sp.facetverts + 10000))
        ) AS efficiency_value
    FROM 
        scanprocessing sp
    JOIN 
        scans s ON sp.equipref = s.equipref AND sp.zoneref = s.zoneref
    GROUP BY 
        sp.flowsoft, sp.flowstage
)
SELECT 
    processing_software,
    processing_stage,
    avg_processing_hours,
    avg_cpu_usage_percent,
    avg_gpu_usage_percent,
    avg_data_size_gb,
    efficiency_value,
    -- Determine efficiency status based on efficiency value
    CASE 
        WHEN efficiency_value < 0.5 THEN 'High Efficiency'
        WHEN efficiency_value < 1.0 THEN 'Moderate Efficiency'
        ELSE 'Bottleneck'
    END AS efficiency_status,
    -- Count total workflows for each software and stage
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY processing_software, processing_stage) AS total_workflows
FROM 
    EfficiencyMetrics;
